title: Shedeur Sanders on QB competition: I'm not a judge, my focus is on improvement

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Shedeur Sanders on QB competition: I'm not a judge, my focus is on improvement
sources.description: Browns head coach Todd Monken said multiple times this offseason that he hoped to decide on a starting quarterback by the end of the team's spring practices, but he said this week that no determination has been made.
